sections.text:
THE INSPECTION PERSPECTIVE

A remote view.
A closer understanding.

Inside a tank. Along a stack. Across a building’s exterior. Some conditions are difficult to see from the ground.

We’re Sky I. We use drones to inspect industrial interiors and exteriors, with window washing as a separate service.

Tell us the structure, location and area of concern. We’ll start by discussing access, site conditions and the work required.

THERE’S MORE TO OUR PERSPECTIVE.

More about Sky I
01
TANK INSPECTIONS

Internal spaces, walls, roofs and bases

02
STACK INSPECTIONS

Chimneys, stacks and tall structures

03
BUILDING SURVEYS

Facades, cladding and structures

DIFFERENT CHALLENGES.
A CLEARER WAY FORWARD.

It starts with your question.

An interior inspection, an exterior survey and a window washing enquiry begin with different site questions. We discuss the area to cover, the conditions around it and the documentation or cleaning requirement before agreeing the approach.

Sky I brings the inspection perspective. When the next step needs physical access, Skyriders brings rope-access inspection, maintenance and repair.

Meet Skyriders, our rope access sister company

Gaborone, Botswana

The value was in seeing the area we were discussing. It gave our site team and maintenance team a common starting point.

Plant maintenance team
Mpumalanga, South Africa

Being able to look at the enclosed space together made the next discussion with our engineers far more specific.

Industrial engineering team
Limpopo, South Africa
